lines: This indeed śakti-mudrā if hands run downward; of ten fingers but after fist binding.
l4.sanskrit_cite: eṣaiva śaktimudrā cedadhodhāvitapāṇikā daśānāmaṅgulīnāṃ tu muṣṭibandhādanantaram
